annotations.title: Security headers check, HTTP: audit a page's security headers

description: Fetch a public URL and grade its HTTP security headers: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, framing protection, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, plus version leaks (Server, X-Powered-By) and cookies missing Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite. Returns a grade A-F, a score and each check with its value. Use to review a site's basic web security; for DNS and email records use domain. Private hosts are refused with 400, uncharged. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
